title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Haynes claimed off waivers by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins claimed OL Christian Haynes off waivers from the Seahawks.
items.impact: It was announced that the Ravens had claimed Haynes off waivers. The Dolphins had a higher claim and were awarded Haynes.

items.title: Jaydon Blue signs with Eagles' 53-man roster
items.desc: The Eagles signed RB Jaydon Blue to their 53-man roster from the practice squad.
items.impact: Dameon Pierce was placed on the injured list as the corresponding move. Blue will remain off the fantasy radar.

items.impact: Pierce becomes the latest Eagles running back to go down with an injury. He'll miss at least the next four weeks.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jaylin Noel (toe) placed on IR
items.desc: Jaylin Noel (toe) has been placed on IR due to his turf toe injury.
items.impact: Noel suffered the injury in the Texans Week 7 loss to the Giants. He will miss a minimum of four games. Marvin Harrison Jr., Tank Dell, and Kayshon Boutte will all see a slight bump in work with Noel out, with the primary beneficiary likely Dell.

items.title: Anthony Gould (concussion) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Anthony Gould (concussion) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Gould is still going through the NFL's concussion protocols and was limited on Wednesday as a result. He seems likely to be cleared in time to play in Week 8, but that won't come until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Warren (groin) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Tyler Warren (groin) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Warren was able to participate in Wednesday's practice. He has missed multiple games while dealing with this groin issue, but it looks like he's trending towards making his return in Week 8. He will be a must-start fantasy option if active, even with Indianapolis getting rid of several key players for future picks.

items.author: Leo Sells

items.impact: Zaccheaus is managing a minor shoulder issue right now and was limited at practice on Wednesday as a result. He remains off of the fantasy radar right now regardless of his health status, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) did not take part in Atlanta's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Robinson missed last week's game due to a hamstring issue, and he was a non-participant on Wednesday for the same reason. He may very well miss this week's game because of it as well, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) questionable to play Thursday
items.desc: Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) is questionable to play in Thursday night's game against the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Golden is uncertain to play on Thursday night. He's dealing with a pair of injuries right now and is officially considered questionable to play as a result. The team will make a decision about his availability closer to game time, but fantasy managers should still feel comfortable starting him if he's cleared and will see a full workload against the Panthers.
